note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md for Quran 2:124-152 (2026-11-26): 17 pictures from 34 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. The Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God and the angels are not pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition; nothing violent. Tried and not chosen: Geese fly in a V across a sunrise, one goose in front leading the others. A man scrubs a worn stone doorstep clean with a brush as people walk past into a plain house. A table of ripe fruit in a quiet courtyard in the evening. A father and his grown son carry a block of stone between them across bare ground to a foundation trench. A path of flat stones is laid one by one across a meadow toward a far ridge. A child falls backward with open arms into her father's waiting arms. A father and his three grown sons stand on a hill at sunset looking over a valley, the father's hand on the nearest son's shoulder. A family photograph of many generations fades on a mantel by a window. Footprints on a beach are being washed away by a wave. Flowers of many different kinds are gathered in one vase of clear water. Rolls of cloth in many colors hang drying on a long line in the wind. A man in a witness box presses his lips shut with papers hidden behind his back as a room waits. A person stands exactly in the middle of a long bridge, equally far from both banks. A compass needle swings and settles to point firmly in one direction on a flat rock. A mother picks out her own grown daughter from a big group photograph at once. Cyclists climb a mountain road toward a bright summit. Two lit windows glow across a dark valley at night, one answering the other.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Abraham is tested with words and made a leader for the people, but the covenant does not reach wrongdoers; the House is made a place of return and safety, to be kept pure, and Abraham asks for a safe land with fruits.
ideas: Geese in V formation led by one goose across a sunrise
A mountain guide roping a line of climbers up a ridge
Two people sweeping a plain stone room clean in a shaft of sun
A man scrubbing a worn stone step while others pass
A green orchard in a safe desert valley town
A courtyard table of fruit in the evening

sections.meaning: Abraham and Ishmael raise the foundations of the House and pray: accept it from us, make us submit, raise up among them a messenger.
ideas: Two pairs of hands lowering one stone into a foundation course
A father and a son carrying a block between them
An old man planting an olive sapling while a child holds the watering can
A path being laid stone by stone toward a far ridge

sections.meaning: The creed of Abraham is submission, and he and Jacob charged their sons with it; a community that has passed away has what it earned, and you have what you earned.
ideas: A swimmer floating on his back with open arms on calm water
A child falling backward into a father's arms
A worn pouch of seeds passed from hand to hand
An old man in bed with his grown sons gathered close
Footprints on sand being washed away by a wave
An old family photograph fading on a mantel

sections.meaning: Follow the creed of Abraham, not a label; we make no distinction between any of the messengers; the dye of God, whose dye is better?; and who does greater wrong than one who conceals a testimony he has from God?
ideas: A row of different cups filled exactly to the same line
Different flowers in one vase
A skein of wool lifted from a deep blue dye vat
Many colored fabrics drying on a line
A witness in a courtroom pressing his lips shut with papers behind his back
A man hiding a sealed envelope as a crowd waits at the door

sections.meaning: To God belong the east and the west; a middle community to be witnesses over the people; turn your face to the Sacred Place of Worship; those who were given the Book recognize it as they recognize their sons.
ideas: A level balance scale with one stone in each pan against a sunrise
A person standing midway on a long bridge
A field of sunflowers all turned to the morning sun
A compass needle swinging and settling
A father picking out his own son among many children at a school gate
A mother recognizing her daughter in a crowd photo

sections.meaning: Each has a direction he turns toward, so race to what is good; remember me and I will remember you, and give thanks.
ideas: Runners in separate lanes toward a lit finish line
Cyclists climbing a mountain road
Two hilltop fires at dusk answering each other across a dark valley
A signal lamp answered from a far window

scenes.principle: And when his Lord tested Abraham with words, he fulfilled them. He said, "I am making you a leader for the people." He said, "And of my descendants?" He said, "My covenant does not reach the wrongdoers."
scenes.shows: A mountain guide at the front of a roped line of climbers leads the way up a ridge in morning light.
scenes.prompt: A mountain guide at the front of a roped line of climbers in plain outdoor gear leading them up a snowy ridge in clear morning light, seen from behind. The guide and the climbers are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we made the House a place of return for the people and a place of safety. And take from the place where Abraham stood a place of prayer.
scenes.shows: Two people sweep clean a plain stone room with a broom in a shaft of light from a window.
scenes.prompt: In a plain empty stone room with one tall window, two people in plain clothes sweep the stone floor clean with brooms, dust floating in a shaft of morning sun, a clean pale floor. There is no symbol of any religion in the room. The two people are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a safe land, and provide its people with fruits, those of them who believe in God and the Last Day," he said, "And whoever disbelieves, I will let him enjoy himself a little, then I will force him ...
scenes.shows: A green orchard of fruit trees fills a safe quiet valley in the desert, with a small town at the edge.
scenes.prompt: A green orchard of pomegranate and fig and date trees heavy with fruit fills a quiet valley between dry desert hills, a small plain town at its edge with open doors and children's laundry hanging, golden afternoon light. The orchard and the town are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House, and Ishmael: "Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
scenes.shows: Two pairs of hands, a man's and a younger man's, lower one stone together into a foundation.
scenes.prompt: Close on two pairs of hands, an older man's and a younger man's, lowering one rough block of stone together into the first course of a house foundation in a shallow trench, dust and morning sun. The hands and the stone are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Our Lord, and raise up among them a messenger from among them, who will recite your signs to them and teach them the Book and wisdom and cleanse them. You are the Mighty, the Wise."
scenes.shows: An old man plants an olive sapling while a small child holds a watering can beside him.
scenes.prompt: An old man in plain clothes plants a small olive sapling in the dry earth of a hillside while a small child beside him holds a watering can, ready to water it, golden light. The old man, the child and the sapling are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted to the Lord of the worlds."
scenes.shows: A swimmer floats on his back on calm water with his arms open, letting the water hold him.
scenes.prompt: A swimmer in plain swimwear floats on his back on perfectly calm clear water with both arms open wide, completely relaxed, eyes closed, held up by the water, sun above. The swimmer is in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Abraham charged his sons with it, and so did Jacob: "My sons, God has chosen the religion for you, so do not die except as people who submit."
scenes.shows: An old man's hands pass a worn leather pouch of seeds across a table to his son's hands.
scenes.prompt: Close on an old man's weathered hands passing a worn leather pouch of seeds across a wooden table to a younger man's waiting hands, soft window light. The hands and the pouch are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Or were you witnesses when death came to Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your god and the god of your fathers, Abraham, Ishmael and Isaac, one god, and to him we submit."
scenes.shows: An old man lies in a bed at dusk with his grown sons gathered close, holding his hands.
scenes.prompt: A very old man lies in a plain bed at dusk in a simple room with his grown sons gathered close around him, holding his hands, listening to him with serious faces, warm window light. The old man and his sons are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: That is a community that has passed away. It has what it earned, and you have what you earned, and you will not be asked about what they used to do.
scenes.shows: An empty old rocking chair on a porch in the evening, still gently moving.
scenes.prompt: An empty old wooden rocking chair on a porch in evening light, still moving gently as if someone just left, a field beyond. The chair is in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Say, "We believe in God and what has been sent down to us, and what was sent down to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the tribes, and what Moses and Jesus were given, and what the prophets were given from their Lord.
scenes.shows: A row of different cups and glasses, each filled exactly to the same line with water.
scenes.prompt: Five very different cups, a mug, a glass, a bowl, a tin cup and a jar, in a row on a wooden table in soft light, each filled with clear water exactly to the same height. The row of cups is in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: "The dye of God, and whose dye is better than God's? And it is him we worship."
scenes.shows: Hands lift a skein of wool from a deep blue dye vat, dyed all the way through.
scenes.prompt: Close on a pair of hands lifting a heavy skein of wool dripping deep blue out of a large wooden dye vat, the blue colored all the way through, soft outdoor light. The hands and the wool are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Or do you say that Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the tribes were Jews or Christians? Say, "Do you know better, or does God?" And who does greater wrong than one who conceals a testimony he has from God?
scenes.shows: A man slides a sealed envelope into a drawer and shuts it while a crowd waits at his door.
scenes.prompt: A man in plain clothes slides a sealed envelope into a desk drawer and shuts it tight, while through the glass door behind him a crowd of people waits expectantly. The man and the drawer are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And that is how we have made you a middle community, so that you may be witnesses over the people and the messenger may be a witness over you.
scenes.shows: A perfectly level balance scale with one stone in each pan stands against the sunrise.
scenes.prompt: A brass balance scale perfectly level with one smooth stone in each pan, standing on a flat rock against a glowing sunrise sky. The scale is in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: We do see your face turning about in the sky, so we will certainly turn you to a direction you will be pleased with. So turn your face toward the Sacred Place of Worship, and wherever you are, turn your faces toward it.
scenes.shows: A field of sunflowers all turned the same way toward the morning sun.
scenes.prompt: A wide field of sunflowers all turning their faces the same direction toward the low morning sun, golden light across them. The sunflowers are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Those to whom we gave the Book recognize it as they recognize their sons, but a group of them conceal the truth while they know.
scenes.shows: A father at a school gate scans a crowd of children and his face lights up when he sees his own son.
scenes.prompt: At a school gate in afternoon light, a father in plain clothes scans a crowd of dozens of children and his whole face lights up as he recognizes his own son at once. The father and the crowd are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And each has a direction he turns toward, so race to what is good. Wherever you are, God will bring you all together. God has power over all things.
scenes.shows: Runners in separate lanes race toward a finish line in the sunshine.
scenes.prompt: Runners in plain athletic clothes racing in separate lanes of a track toward a finish tape in bright morning sunshine, seen from the front low, determined. The runners are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: So remember me, and I will remember you. And give thanks to me, and do not be ungrateful to me.
scenes.shows: Two hilltop fires burn at dusk on opposite sides of a dark valley, answering each other.
scenes.prompt: At dusk, two small bonfires burn on two opposite hilltops across a dark valley, each answering the other's light, the sky deep blue. The two fires are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.
